analysis.rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosted page likely has an incomplete or inconsistent destination data mapping for the GLOCAL programme detail page. Although the visible scholarship links point to the correct programme-overview URL, the Netherlands destination appears to be omitted or not rendered, and the Spain/Japan destination comparison plus catalogue officialUrl assertions are not returning matching data for verification. This suggests a host-side content/configuration issue such as missing destination entry, stale cached data, or a mismatch between the page link hrefs and the underlying catalogue officialUrl fields. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The GLOCAL detail page shows the required institutions and all seven study-location scholarship links use the specified official programme-overview URL. The destination comparison is incomplete, so the required same-link and catalogue officialUrl assertions could not be verified for every destination.

Observations:
- The detail page lists University of Glasgow, Kyoto University, and Universidad de Los Andes.
- All seven “Scholarship information” links have the href https://globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu/about-glocal/programme-overview/.
- The Netherlands result was not checked; Spain and Japan link comparisons and the per-destination catalogue officialUrl checks remain unverified.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Check the GLOCAL detail page data/source used on the hosted build and make sure every study-location destination is fully present and consistently mapped to the exact same official programme-overview URL. In particular, verify that the Netherlands destination is not missing or conditionally filtered out, and that the Spain and Japan destination records expose the same href in both the page links and the destination catalogue officialUrl fields. If these values come from CMS/API/static JSON, rebuild or redeploy after correcting the incomplete dataset or mapping logic, and ensure the page renders all destination entries before the test reads them (no client-side race/hydration mismatch).
